paragraphs.text: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God`s elect, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
paragraphs.original: Παῦλος δοῦλος θεοῦ, ἀπόστολος δὲ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ κατὰ πίστιν ἐκλεκτῶν θεοῦ καὶ ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας τῆς κατʼ εὐσέβειαν
paragraphs.translit: Paulos doulos theou, apostolos de Iēsou Christou kata pistin eklektōn theou kai epignōsin alētheias tēs katʼ eusebeian

paragraphs.text: in hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before times eternal;
paragraphs.original: ἐπʼ ἐλπίδι ζωῆς αἰωνίου, ἣν ἐπηγγείλατο ὁ ἀψευδὴς θεὸς πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων
paragraphs.translit: epʼ elpidi zōēs aiōniou, hēn epēngeilato ho apseudēs theos pro chronōn aiōniōn

paragraphs.text: but in his own seasons manifested his word in the message, wherewith I was intrusted according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
paragraphs.original: ἐφανέρωσεν δὲ καιροῖς ἰδίοις, τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ἐν κηρύγματι ὃ ἐπιστεύθην ἐγὼ κατʼ ἐπιταγὴν τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: ephanerōsen de kairois idiois, ton logon autou en kērygmati ho episteuthēn egō katʼ epitagēn tou sōtēros hēmōn theou,

paragraphs.text: to Titus, my true child after a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.
paragraphs.original: Τίτῳ γνησίῳ τέκνῳ κατὰ κοινὴν πίστιν· χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Titō gnēsiō teknō kata koinēn pistin· charis kai eirēnē apo theou patros kai Christou Iēsou tou sōtēros hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that were wanting, and appoint elders in every city, as I gave thee charge;
paragraphs.original: Τούτου χάριν ἀπέλιπόν σε ἐν Κρήτῃ ἵνα τὰ λείποντα ἐπιδιορθώσῃ, καὶ καταστήσῃς κατὰ πόλιν πρεσβυτέρους, ὡς ἐγώ σοι διεταξάμην,
paragraphs.translit: Toutou charin apelipon se en Krētē hina ta leiponta epidiorthōsē, kai katastēsēs kata polin presbyterous, hōs egō soi dietaxamēn,

paragraphs.text: if any man is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children that believe, who are not accused of riot or unruly.
paragraphs.original: εἴ τίς ἐστιν ἀνέγκλητος, μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἀνήρ, τέκνα ἔχων πιστά, μὴ ἐν κατηγορίᾳ ἀσωτίας ἢ ἀνυπότακτα.
paragraphs.translit: ei tis estin anenklētos, mias gynaikos anēr, tekna echōn pista, mē en katēgoria asōtias ē anypotakta.

paragraphs.text: For the bishop must be blameless, as God`s steward; not self-willed, not soon angry, no brawler, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre;
paragraphs.original: δεῖ γὰρ τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ἀνέγκλητον εἶναι ὡς θεοῦ οἰκονόμον, μὴ αὐθάδη, μὴ ὀργίλον, μὴ πάροινον, μὴ πλήκτην, μὴ αἰσχροκερδῆ,
paragraphs.translit: dei gar ton episkopon anenklēton einai hōs theou oikonomon, mē authadē, mē orgilon, mē paroinon, mē plēktēn, mē aischrokerdē,

paragraphs.text: but given to hospitality, as lover of good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled;
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ φιλόξενον, φιλάγαθον, σώφρονα, δίκαιον, ὅσιον, ἐγκρατῆ,
paragraphs.translit: alla philoxenon, philagathon, sōphrona, dikaion, hosion, enkratē,

paragraphs.text: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict the gainsayers.
paragraphs.original: ἀντεχόμενον τοῦ κατὰ τὴν διδαχὴν πιστοῦ λόγου, ἵνα δυνατὸς ᾖ καὶ παρακαλεῖν ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ καὶ τοὺς ἀντιλέγοντας ἐλέγχειν.
paragraphs.translit: antechomenon tou kata tēn didachēn pistou logou, hina dynatos ē kai parakalein en tē didaskalia tē hygiainousē kai tous antilegontas elenchein.

paragraphs.text: For there are many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision,
paragraphs.original: Εἰσὶν γὰρ πολλοὶ καὶ ἀνυπότακτοι, ματαιολόγοι καὶ φρεναπάται, μάλιστα οἱ ἐκ τῆς περιτομῆς,
paragraphs.translit: Eisin gar polloi kai anypotaktoi, mataiologoi kai phrenapatai, malista hoi ek tēs peritomēs,

paragraphs.text: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre`s sake.
paragraphs.original: οὓς δεῖ ἐπιστομίζειν, οἵτινες ὅλους οἴκους ἀνατρέπουσιν διδάσκοντες ἃ μὴ δεῖ αἰσχροῦ κέρδους χάριν.
paragraphs.translit: hous dei epistomizein, hoitines holous oikous anatrepousin didaskontes ha mē dei aischrou kerdous charin.

paragraphs.text: One of themselves, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons.
paragraphs.original: εἶπέν τις ἐξ αὐτῶν, ἴδιος αὐτῶν προφήτης, Κρῆτες ἀεὶ ψεῦσται, κακὰ θηρία, γαστέρες ἀργαί·
paragraphs.translit: eipen tis ex autōn, idios autōn prophētēs, Krētes aei pseustai, kaka thēria, gasteres argai·

paragraphs.text: This testimony is true. For which cause reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
paragraphs.original: ἡ μαρτυρία αὕτη ἐστὶν ἀληθής. διʼ ἣν αἰτίαν ἔλεγχε αὐτοὺς ἀποτόμως, ἵνα ὑγιαίνωσιν ἐν τῇ πίστει,
paragraphs.translit: hē martyria hautē estin alēthēs. diʼ hēn aitian elenche autous apotomōs, hina hygiainōsin en tē pistei,

paragraphs.text: not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
paragraphs.original: μὴ προσέχοντες Ἰουδαϊκοῖς μύθοις καὶ ἐντολαῖς ἀνθρώπων ἀποστρεφομένων τὴν ἀλήθειαν.
paragraphs.translit: mē prosechontes Ioudaikois mythois kai entolais anthrōpōn apostrephomenōn tēn alētheian.

paragraphs.text: To the pure all things are pure: but to them that are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
paragraphs.original: πάντα καθαρὰ τοῖς καθαροῖς· τοῖς δὲ μεμιαμμένοις καὶ ἀπίστοις οὐδὲν καθαρόν, ἀλλὰ μεμίανται αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ συνείδησις.
paragraphs.translit: panta kathara tois katharois· tois de memiammenois kai apistois ouden katharon, alla memiantai autōn kai ho nous kai hē syneidēsis.

paragraphs.text: They profess that they know God; but by their works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
paragraphs.original: θεὸν ὁμολογοῦσιν εἰδέναι, τοῖς δὲ ἔργοις ἀρνοῦνται, βδελυκτοὶ ὄντες καὶ ἀπειθεῖς καὶ πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἀδόκιμοι.
paragraphs.translit: theon homologousin eidenai, tois de ergois arnountai, bdelyktoi ontes kai apeitheis kai pros pan ergon agathon adokimoi.
